component.name: Caliber
component.summary: Graphical calculator — Basic, Scientific, Programming, Graphing and more

description.p: Caliber is a full-featured graphical calculator built with C++ and Qt6. It covers every calculation mode you need — from basic arithmetic to 3D function graphing — in a clean, themeable interface.

ul.li: 22 calculator modes: Basic, Scientific, Programming, Date, Conversion, Equations, Graphing, Statistics, Calculus, Financial, Number Theory, Electrical, Digital Logic, Vectors, Physics, Chemistry, Civil/Mech, Advanced Math, Discrete Math, MCS, Signal Processing, Control Systems
2D and 3D function plotter with zoom, pan, rotation, polar/parametric modes
9 built-in themes + custom gradient theme builder + community theme support
History panel with search, filter, pin, and export
Step-by-step solver breakdowns across multiple modes
